label: database-row-insert-baseline
notes: First trustworthy foreground measurement of the database row insert path.
Captured after: shadow-repo snapshot fast path (582ac496), refresh-scheduler
starvation fix (29f6787b), collapsed-skills gating (6629db4d), and immediate

never enter the DOM (rowInsertPaintedSamples records how many did).
